Routines

top source chromis::plot_pointing

SST pipeline

chromis::plot_pointing [, file=varies]

Plot pointing during a day.

Keywords

file in optional type=varies

If a string, then plot to a file with this name, else if TRUE then print to the default file "dir-analysis/pointing.png".
